subject: Request to keep pilot live during procurement hold — Pacifica Health
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@pacificahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@pacificahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Mar 2025 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot pause — procurement routing (Pacifica)

Hi Marissa,

Quick heads up — our procurement team put a temporary hold on new vendor spend while we finish an internal vendor review. The pilot is live but finance has flagged the SOW and put it in a queue; we don't expect more than a week delay but it will definitely impact our demo cadence.

Two asks: 1) Can you keep our sandbox/live access active so the clinical team can finish the evaluation? 2) If needed, would Redwood consider a short-term top-up or voucher so we don't lose momentum while purchase orders route?

I've attached the SOW we signed with a couple of redlines and a screenshot from procurement showing the routing status. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Clinical Ops
Pacifica Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@pacificahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Mar 2025 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot pause — procurement routing (Pacifica)

Hi Lena — thanks for the note and for sending the SOW. Sorry to hear procurement has the queue — we've seen that slow down momentum.

Short answers: yes, we can keep the environment running for the evaluation window; and we can discuss a small interim credit/voucher to bridge the gap while PO processes. I looped in Ben (AM) to coordinate the details and confirm approvals.

Ben — can you review Pacifica's current usage and propose a bridging option (48–72 hour top-up vs. 7‑day voucher)? If we need a manager sign-off for anything >$X, please advise and I'll escalate.

Lena — if you can confirm the expected window (best guess) and whether the clinical team needs additional seat provisioning, that helps us size the short-term grant.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@pacificahealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Mar 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot pause — procurement routing (Pacifica)

Thanks Marissa / Lena — reviewed Pacifica's sandbox usage for the last two weeks. They are consistently hitting 6–8 concurrent sessions during clinician testing and ~120k tokens/day. At current run-rate a 72‑hour top-up (equivalent to $1,200 in trial credits) would keep the key flows active while procurement clears.

Options I recommend:
- 72-hour top-up voucher (small, quick to provision) — low friction
- 7-day voucher (if procurement says the hold will be longer) — requires manager approval

Markus — can you sign off on the 7‑day option if needed? If not, I'll provision the 72‑hour grant today so nothing stalls.

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@pacificahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Mar 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot pause — procurement routing (Pacifica)

Ben — approve the 72‑hour top-up (up to $1,500). If procurement confirms the delay will exceed 5 business days, come back to me and I'll approve a 7‑day voucher. Please add a note to the deal for billing reconciliation and mark the credit as "bridging" pending PO DL-2024-0892.

Marissa — please proceed and confirm once the voucher is issued.

Markus Klein
Revenue Operations (Interim)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@pacificahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Mar 2025 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot pause — procurement routing (Pacifica)

Lena — all set. I issued a 72‑hour bridging voucher for Pacifica (code: PW-72-PAC-030125) that adds the equivalent of $1,200 in credits to your sandbox. This should keep the clinician flows and integrations active while procurement routes the PO.

Next steps:
- We'll hold invoice reconciliation until the PO clears (internal note added to deal DL-2024-0892).
- If procurement indicates the hold will exceed five business days, reply here and we'll escalate a 7‑day voucher.

Attachment included: confirmation stub of the voucher and internal reconciliation link.

Best of luck getting the routing cleared — let me know if you want a 20‑minute call for stakeholders this week.

—Marissa
